shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST NativeReplicationRemoteTarget resources

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: leading_vip
options.description:
Any one of the IP addresses that belong to the remote peer's replication VIP pool. This IP is used for the
initial connection between the peers.

options.name: mss
options.description: Maximum segment size (MSS), in bytes, that the peer can receive in a single TCP segment.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the peer configuration, reflected also on the remote cluster.

options.name: pool_id
options.description: The ID of the local replication VIP Pool

options.name: remote_vips
options.description:
The IP addresses that belong to the remote peer's replication VIP pool. This IP is used for the initial
connection between the peers. Once the connection is established, the peers share their external network topology
and form multiple connections between the VIPs.

options.name: secure_mode
options.description:
Secure mode: NONE=no encryption on the replication connection. SECURE=Replication to this peer will be encrypted
over the wire with mTLS. Requires a certificate, key and root certificate to be uploaded to VMS on each peer
cluster. Upload mTLS certificates with PATCH /clusters/{id}/.

options.name: transport_mode
options.description:
Transport mode: TCP for FIPS compliance, QUIC is not FIPS compliance but good for lower latency in high-latency
networks.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
